subject: general
question:
Select the correct balanced chemical equation for the given reaction.

Zinc + Silver nitrate → Zinc nitrate + Silver
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zn (s) + 2AgNO3 (aq) → Zn(NO3)2 (aq) + 2Ag(s).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical formula of zinc is Zn.
 
• The chemical formula of silver nitrate is AgNO₃.
 
• The chemical formula of zinc nitrate is Zn(NO₃)₂ .
 
• And the chemical formula of silver is Ag.
 
• The reaction will be: Zn (s) + 2AgNO3 (aq) → Zn(NO3)2 (aq) + 2Ag(s).__
